branch_contract.branch_rule: Once one semantic piece is actually contested, follow the branch keyed by route_key and piece_key to one approved terminal field instead of treating the route's coarse escalation list as the final proof trace.
branch_contract.piece_link_rule: A challenge branch must use a piece_key and terminal_stop_field already approved by the companion stop profile for the same question family.
branch_contract.route_link_rule: A challenge branch must begin at the start_path declared by its companion audience-keyed route.

escalation_sequence.why: start from the public wrapper sentence
split the wrapper sentence into its narrower supported claims
this verdict owns the continuity half of the wrapper claim

terminal_stop_field.why_stop_here: This is the approved continuity owner for the contested piece.

branches.why: If the continuity half of the public wrapper sentence is challenged, do not stop at the wrapper or at the coarse route list; end at the continuity decision token.

escalation_sequence.why: start from the public wrapper sentence
split the wrapper sentence into its narrower supported claims
this verdict owns the package-closure half of the wrapper claim

terminal_stop_field.why_stop_here: This is the approved closure owner for the contested piece.

branches.why: Closure disputes on the public wrapper sentence end at the closure-status token, not at the wrapper prose.

escalation_sequence.why: the compare report already owns the compact numeric delta

terminal_stop_field.why_stop_here: This is the smallest numeric diff owner.

branches.why: Some compact-diff challenges stop immediately because the compare report already owns the contested numeric delta.

escalation_sequence.why: start at the shipped compact diff object
move left to the replay-facing recomputation witness

terminal_stop_field.why_stop_here: This is the approved replay-facing witness for the recompute piece.

branches.why: When the numeric delta itself is not enough, the branch continues to the recomputed replay totals.

escalation_sequence.why: start at the shipped compact diff object
move left to the changed-family owner

terminal_stop_field.why_stop_here: This verdict owns the narrow changed-family slice.

branches.why: Changed-family disputes end at the continuity verdict's changed-line-items slice.

escalation_sequence.why: the referee starts one layer left at the support map
follow the continuity support edge to the owning verdict

terminal_stop_field.why_stop_here: This is the approved continuity owner.

branches.why: The referee continuity branch starts from support, then ends at the continuity token.

escalation_sequence.why: the referee starts one layer left at the support map
follow the closure support edge to the owning verdict

terminal_stop_field.why_stop_here: This is the approved closure owner.

branches.why: The referee closure branch ends at the closure-status token.

escalation_sequence.why: the referee starts at the role-row bridge

terminal_stop_field.why_stop_here: The stop profile approves the row ledger as the owner of satisfied-publication-role rows.

branches.why: Package-completeness questions often terminate at the row ledger, before any compressed closure token.

escalation_sequence.why: start at the role-row bridge
continue to the compressed closure token once the row bindings are understood

terminal_stop_field.why_stop_here: The stop profile approves this token as the narrow closure answer.

branches.why: Once the row ledger is understood, the compressed closure token can discharge the token piece.

escalation_sequence.why: the auditor starts at the narrow token owner

terminal_stop_field.why_stop_here: The status envelope owns the narrow public-status token directly.

branches.why: A token-only challenge may stop immediately at the status envelope.

escalation_sequence.why: start at the narrow token owner
continue to the continuity owner compressed into that token

terminal_stop_field.why_stop_here: This is the approved continuity owner for the token's continuity piece.

branches.why: A continuity challenge on the public-status token ends at the continuity verdict.

escalation_sequence.why: start at the narrow token owner
continue to the closure owner compressed into that token

terminal_stop_field.why_stop_here: This is the approved closure owner for the token's closure piece.

branches.why: A closure challenge on the public-status token ends at the closure verdict.

escalation_sequence.why: the auditor starts at the numeric diff owner

terminal_stop_field.why_stop_here: The compare report is the approved numeric diff owner.

branches.why: Delta-only compact-diff challenges may stop immediately at the compare report.

escalation_sequence.why: start at the numeric diff owner
continue to the replay-facing recomputation witness

terminal_stop_field.why_stop_here: The stop profile approves the verifier recomputation slice for this piece.

branches.why: Auditor recomputation challenges end at the replay-facing verifier output.

escalation_sequence.why: start at the numeric diff owner
continue to the changed-family owner

terminal_stop_field.why_stop_here: The stop profile approves the changed-line-items slice for this piece.

branches.why: Changed-family disputes end at the continuity verdict's changed-line-items slice.

note: Derived piece-keyed challenge-branch map for one concrete successor comparison. It separates route-level audience navigation from the exact piece-specific escalation walk once one semantic piece is actually challenged.
resolution_rule: Pick the audience route first; once a concrete semantic piece is contested, follow the branch keyed by route_key and piece_key to one approved terminal field.
